concepts.name: NDA effective date
justifications: The agreement expressly sets the Effective Date as 1 February 2027, distinct from the parties’ signing date.

concepts.name: NDA permitted purpose
predicted: evaluating a possible minority investment by talus ventures ab in fjordsignal as's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
gold: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
values: Evaluating a possible minority investment by Talus Ventures AB in FjordSignal AS's marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch.
justifications: The agreement identifies this as the sole Permitted Purpose and specifies the investment type, business, and project name.

concepts.name: NDA disclosure window end
justifications: The executed termination notice closes the disclosure window effective 30 November 2027, earlier than its ordinary end date; the return request does not itself terminate the window.

concepts.name: NDA contractual forum
justifications: The agreement designates the courts of Oslo as the parties’ contractual forum.

concepts.name: NDA signatory entities
justifications: FjordSignal AS is identified as a signatory party registered in Norway and acting as the Discloser.
Talus Ventures AB is identified as a signatory party registered in Sweden and acting as the Recipient.

concepts.name: Protected assets at the April snapshot
justifications: LUMEN’s non-public recipe combination remains protected despite its public components, and SHORE’s previously possessed module does not exclude the complete package. CEDAR was publicly released, MICA was independently developed, and BASALT’s breach-caused posting does not establish an exclusion; ORACLE was in the gap before written acceptance at the snapshot.

concepts.name: ORACLE timely confirmation deadline
justifications: Counting five Business Days after the 25 March oral disclosure, excluding the specified non-Business Days, makes 5 April 2027 the final day for timely confirmation.

concepts.name: ORACLE protection timeline
predicted: protection was provisional from the oral disclosure on 25 march 2027 until the five-business-day deadline at 17:00 utc on 5 april. the confirmation was sent before that deadline but reached the mailbox on 6 april at 09:05, so it was late; protection therefore lapsed at the deadline and remained absent until the recipient’s written acceptance on 8 april at 10:00, when protection resumed prospectively. protection was not continuous, and sending did not count as delivery.
gold: oracle is provisionally protected from the 25 march oral disclosure until 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc. confirmation sent before that deadline arrived late on 6 april at 09:05, so protection lapses after the deadline. it resumes prospectively when the recipient expressly accepts on 8 april at 10:00 utc; the gap is not cured retroactively.
values: Protection was provisional from the oral disclosure on 25 March 2027 until the five-Business-Day deadline at 17:00 UTC on 5 April. The confirmation was sent before that deadline but reached the mailbox on 6 April at 09:05, so it was late; protection therefore lapsed at the deadline and remained absent until the Recipient’s written acceptance on 8 April at 10:00, when protection resumed prospectively. Protection was not continuous, and sending did not count as delivery.
justifications: The oral rule provides provisional protection only until the deadline, with late confirmation restoring protection only upon written acceptance. Delivery is determined by mailbox arrival rather than sending.

concepts.name: Entire SHORE package excluded by prior possession
justifications: Prior possession is established only for the smaller module incorporated unchanged in the package. The new branching map, thresholds, and complete package combination were not shown to have been previously possessed, so the whole package is not excluded.

concepts.name: CEDAR end of protection
justifications: The entire schedule was independently and lawfully released to the unrestricted public on this date, establishing the public-information exclusion then. That exclusion ends protection before either ordinary-information duration would otherwise expire.

concepts.name: People permitted LUMEN access at the September snapshot
justifications: Elin meets the employee requirements, Marek is an employee of an entity qualifying as an Affiliate, and Oskar qualifies as a professional adviser relying on his enforceable duty of confidence. Each also has the required security check and named clean-room approval; the other listed people fail an applicable recipient or competitor requirement.

concepts.name: Talus Research qualifying voting percentage
justifications: At the snapshot, the Recipient can count 48% of votes held directly and 4% under a presently effective, irrevocable proxy. The resulting 52% exceeds the more-than-50% Affiliate threshold.

concepts.name: Marek earliest authorised LUMEN access
justifications: Marek's undertaking and security check were effective by 10 September, and Affiliate voting control was in place. His named clean-room approval became effective on 14 September, so access could not begin earlier.

concepts.name: Executed competitor consent date for Pia
Q-27 notice deadline date
justifications: Because notice was initially prohibited, the deadline was the earlier of six continuous hours after the prohibition lifted and the required production time. Six hours after the prohibition lifted at 11:20 on 5 July was 17:20 that day, earlier than the production time.

concepts.name: Q-27 notice lateness in minutes
justifications: The notice had to arrive by 17:20 on 5 July, and the compelled-disclosure notice arrived at 17:55. Actual arrival applies, so it was 35 minutes late.

concepts.name: Q-27 permitted production units
justifications: The final binding narrowing order requires all of P1 and only the non-privileged subsection P3A. P2 and P4 were withdrawn, and P3B was determined to be privileged and outside the production duty.

concepts.name: WORK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The return request was delivered on 22 November, before the termination took effect, so it starts the ten-Business-Day deadline. Counting eligible days after the trigger makes 8 December the deadline; restoration does not restart it.

concepts.name: BK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: BK-1 may remain only until the earlier of its scheduled overwrite and 45 calendar days after the 22 November trigger. Its scheduled overwrite on 30 December occurs before the 45-day limit, and restoration does not alter that schedule.

concepts.name: Artifacts permitted retention at the December snapshot
justifications: ARCH-1 qualifies as the counsel-held archival copy, BK-1 remains within its permitted backup period at the snapshot, and HOLD-1 is covered by a binding order still in force. WORK-1 is an ordinary active copy and NOTE-1 has no applicable retention exception.

concepts.name: NOTE-1 model training permitted as residual knowledge
justifications: NOTE-1 contains deliberately recorded parameter values and reconstruction notes, which are excluded from residual-knowledge permission. Training a model using Confidential Information or derivatives that reveal it is independently prohibited without a separate signed licence, and none is provided.
